ASBESTOS MOTION CALENDAR ON SEP-21-2004 IN DEPT. 206, PLAINTIFF ISIAH DEL REAL'S MOTION TO SPECIALLY SET A TRIAL DATE IS GRANTED PURSUANT TO CCP 36(A)&(D). THE ASBESTOS STATUS CONFERENCE OF 6/15/05 IS VACATED. THE CASE IS SET FOR TRIAL ON 11/29/04 @ 11:15AM IN DEPT. 206; SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE SET FOR 11/19/04 @ 9:30AM IN DEPT. 304. DEFENDANT TEXACO IS SEVERED FROM THIS TRIAL SETTING AND SET FOR A STATUS CONFERENCE ON 12/15/04 @ 1;30PM IN DEPT. 206. PREFERENCE CONDITIONED UPON THE FOLLOWING. 1) PLAINTIFF TO PROVIDE LIST OF ALL PARTIES SERVED OR DISMISSED TO BERRY & BERRY BY CLOSE OF BUSINESS 9/22/04. 2)PLAINTIFFS TO IDENTIFY/MAKE AVAILABLE MR. DEL REAL FOR DEPO BY 10/1/04. 3) IF MR. DEL REAL NOT AVAILABLE, PLAINTIFFS MUST PROVIDE LIST OF PRODUCT ID, CO-WORKER AND FAMILY MEMBER WITNESSES BY 10/1/04. IF NOT PROVIDED, THOSE WITNESSES ARE PRECLUDED FROM TESTIFYING AT TRIAL. PARTIES STIPULATE TO G.O. 140 RE: MOTIONS FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT. WRITTEN ORDER PENDING. JUDGE ROBERT DONDERO, CLERKS DIANNE BOFFI, VERA MU, REPORTER JOANN BRYCE.
